description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Recruiter at Micron Technology, Inc., you will be responsible for providing consultation and counseling to hiring managers, external vendors, colleges, and universities. You will clarify recruiting best practices and constraints to hiring managers and ensure that applicants understand the details around compensation, interviews, and offers. You will maintain recruiting contacts and provide recommendations for company representatives visiting colleges and universities. You will be responsible for understanding the hiring managers head count needs and make sure there is alignment between headcount priorities for the department and the business needs. You will participate extensively in the sourcing, screening, and interviewing process of candidates. You will be responsible for maintaining current knowledge of the company’s financial position, competitive landscape, and locations. You will be responsible for hiring team members by maintaining data in recruiting systems, extending and negotiating offers, initiating on-boarding, and finalizing the hiring process. An additional responsibility will be to participate in or lead recruiting projects that support the company’s involvement in ramps, mergers and acquisitions, etc. while focusing on continuous improvement of recruiting processes.

Responsibilities

•
Consult and Counsel Recruiting Stakeholders

•
Collaborate to Determine Talent Needs with Hiring Managers

•
Sourcing

•
Candidate Assessment

•
Management of Recruiting Process

•
Talent and Offer Negotiation

•
Lead or Participate in Recruiting Projects

•
Market Intelligence

•
Business Acumen

Requirements

•
Bachelor’s degree or higher or equivalent experience

•
3+ years of experience in recruitment, direct sourcing and stakeholder management.

•
Proven experience leading professional hiring or execute scouting strategy.

•
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relations with stakeholders, generate relevant reports based on the analytical tactics.

•
Excellent Japanese communication and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)

•
Recruiting experience in the technology, manufacturing, or semiconductor industry

•
Experience working in a global, matrixed organization and collaborating with international teams

•
Knowledge and hands-on experience with sourcing tools such as Workday, LinkedIn Recruiter, etc.

•
Strong English

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport_japan@micron.com
